placementRule: Skill-focused content appears only on its primary skill page. Mixed-skill passage sets appear once in Passage Practice.

skills.label: Sequence
skills.focus: Explicit and implied order in narratives, procedures, and informational processes.

skills.label: Cause and effect
skills.focus: Explicit/implied causal relationships, contributing conditions, and effects of changes.

skills.label: Compare / contrast
skills.focus: Meaningful similarities, differences, and the criterion used to compare ideas, people, or methods.

skills.label: Inference
skills.focus: Evidence-supported ideas not directly stated in the text.

skills.label: Conclusions
skills.focus: Synthesis of multiple details or ideas into a defensible overall conclusion.

skills.label: Relationships among people/events/ideas
skills.focus: How people, events, ideas, setting, and context interact and develop across a text.
